description: Binary input messages on the ptr/ctl data channels (docs/carson-design.md §8). Little-endian. Each vector: message (as JSON) and its exact encoding (hex). Pointer coordinates are normalized 0..65535 over the display currently being streamed (no display byte: the agent tracks it). Wheel deltas are pixels, DOM sign convention (positive dy = scroll down). Key mods bits: 1 shift, 2 ctrl, 4 alt, 8 meta, 16 caps lock. Clipboard text is UTF-8, sent in chunks; flags bit 0 marks the final chunk.
